Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of WMT.
We delivered record revenue of $15.2 billion this quarter, representing 8% year-over-year growth.
Revenue guidance of $15.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 564 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 87 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $15.2 billion this quarter, representing 8% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
